name: artillery
description: Your Gunboat fires a high-explosive cannon shell that damages enemy buildings. Be careful not to hit your own troops!

name: barrage
description: A rapid fire artillery barrage deals massive damage to buildings in a wide target area. Warning: the Barrage is inaccurate and dangerous to nearby friendly troops!

name: critters
description: Launch these robotic troopers to distract and destroy enemy buildings.

name: cryobomb
description: The Cryo Bomb detonates to cause enemy buildings to freeze across a large area, slowing them down and dealing moderate damage.

name: crystal_critters
description: Releases a cluster of Crystal Critters borrowed from Dr. Kavan that heal wounded troops and disappear after a short duration.

name: crystal_shield
description: Provide troops with crystal shields

name: deployable_turret
description: Some stolen technology from Dr T's laboratories resulted in the creation of the deployable turret. Fire the small turret into the battlefield and watch it sit tight and obliterate the enemy.

name: explosive_drone
description: Fires a cluster of drones that take a short duration to activate, and then make a beeline for the nearest enemy building and explode, dealing damage.

name: flare
description: The Flare can be used to direct your troops. All troops will move towards the Flare while it burns, or attack a building marked by it!

name: medkit
description: Heal your troops on the battlefield. Troops inside the Medkit's area of effect will recover health.

name: remote_defib
description: Temporarily revives fallen troops, except Seekers and Choppas. Latest casualties are revived first. If there is not enough capacity to revive a large troop, Riflemen appear instead.

name: remote_hack
description: Launch the Remote Hack at a defensive building to hack it and turn it against other defenses for a duration. Once the hacking effect expires, the building is stunned for a time. Does not work on resource or HQ buildings.

name: shock_bomb
description: The Shock Bomb stuns anything it hits for a short time. Use it to disable key defensive buildings. If you hit your own troops, they will be stunned as well!

name: smoke
description: Protect your troops with a Smoke Screen. Troops inside the smoke can move, but cannot fire or be fired upon.

name: speed_serum
description: A projectile vial full of Super Secret Sauce which energizes the troops, boosting their movement and attack speed for a short duration. Caution: side effects not thoroughly tested.

name: super_warrior
description: A supercharged warrior who fearlessly hurls himself into the heart of the action. Apart from healing himself with every attack, the super warrior also freezes the building it attacks, reducing its attack rate.

name: tiny_shock
description: Launch the Tiny Shock at a defensive building and stun and freeze it for a long duration. Use it to disable key defensive buildings! Only targets a single structure.

name: boom_cannon
description: The Boom Cannon fires devastating shots, but takes a while to reload. Even the strongest armor is no match for the Boom!

name: boom_surprise_1
description: Powerful 2-shot cannon with good range. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

name: boom_surprise_2
description: Powerful 2-shot cannon with good range. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

name: boom_surprise_3
description: Powerful 2-shot cannon with good range. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

name: cannon
description: Cannons fire powerful, large caliber shells towards one target at a time. This makes them ideal against heavy and armored enemies, but less effective against massed infantry.

name: critter_launcher
description: The Critter Launcher lobs critters at a long distance. These critters are not only a great distraction but also deal a lot of damage!

name: damage_amplifier_1
description: Amplifies the damage output of all nearby defenses using a gauss overdrive field.

name: damage_amplifier_2
description: Amplifies the damage output of all nearby defenses using a high voltage gauss overdrive field.

name: damage_amplifier_3
description: Amplifies the damage output of all nearby defenses using a high voltage hyperbolic gauss overdrive field.

name: doom_cannon_1
description: Shoots a Doom Ray that destroys most targets outright. Very slow rate of fire.

name: doom_cannon_2
description: Shoots a Doom Ray that destroys most targets outright. Very slow rate of fire.

name: doom_cannon_3
description: Shoots a Doom Ray that destroys most targets outright. Very slow rate of fire.

name: engine_room
description: The engine rooms power the mighty Warships. Destroy all Engine Rooms to destroy the Warship.

name: flame_thrower
description: The Flamethrower is a close range weapon that deals huge amounts of damage. It's especially deadly against massed infantry. Enemies will also burn for a while after being attacked by the Flamethrower.

name: flotsam_cannon_1
description: The mine wasn't dangerous enough, so they put a cannon on it! Potent defensive cannon that when destroyed detonates with a powerful explosion, causing damage in an area.

name: flotsam_cannon_2
description: The mine wasn't dangerous enough, so they put a cannon on it! Potent defensive cannon that when destroyed detonates with a powerful explosion, causing damage in an area.

name: flotsam_cannon_3
description: The mine wasn't dangerous enough, so they put a cannon on it! Potent defensive cannon that when destroyed detonates with a powerful explosion, causing damage in an area.

name: grappler_1
description: Shoots a long range grappling hook that pulls a single enemy unit close. Slowest firing Grappler.

name: grappler_2
description: Shoots a long range grappling hook that pulls a single enemy unit close. Faster reload speed.

name: grappler_3
description: Shoots a long range grappling hook that pulls a single enemy unit close. Fastest firing Grappler.

name: gunboat
description: The Gunboat provides fire support and battlefield supplies to your troops. It can also relay movement orders with Flares. Upgrade your Headquarters to access new Gunboat abilities, and upgrade the Gunboat to increase its Energy capacity.

name: hot_pot_1
description: Powerful flamethrower with improved reach. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

name: hot_pot_2
description: Powerful flamethrower with improved reach. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

name: hot_pot_3
description: Powerful flamethrower with improved reach. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

name: landing_craft
description: Each Landing Craft carries a squad of troops for beach assaults. Upgrade the Landing Craft to carry more troops to the battle!

name: laser_beam_1
description: Future warfare! Lazor beams burn through any target, causing moderate damage to all enemies in its path.

name: laser_beam_2
description: Future warfare! Lazor beams burn through any target, causing serious damage to all enemies in its path.

name: laser_beam_3
description: Future warfare! Lazor beams burn through any target, causing grievous damage to all enemies in its path.

name: machine_gun
description: The Machine Gun turret sprays bullets at the enemy, rapidly dealing damage to massed infantry at close to medium range.

name: microwaver_1
description: Burns all enemies within range with dangerous microwave radiation. Damages enemies under smoke. Can also be used to make popcorn.

name: microwaver_2
description: Burns all enemies within range with dangerous microwave radiation. Damages enemies under smoke. Can also be used to make popcorn.

name: microwaver_3
description: Burns all enemies within range with dangerous microwave radiation. Damages enemies under smoke. Can also be used to make popcorn.

name: mortar
description: The Mortar is an artillery piece that is effective at medium to long range, but can't target enemies right next to it. Mortar shells explode and deal damage to all troops in the area of effect.

name: rocket_launcher
description: The Rocket Launcher is a long distance artillery piece. It fires a salvo of rockets, followed by a significant reload time.

name: shield_generator_1
description: Generates a force field around the Headquarters that shields it from damage. If the generator is destroyed, the shield dissipates.

name: shield_generator_2
description: Generates a megawatt force field around the Headquarters that shields it from damage. If the generator is destroyed, the shield dissipates.

name: shield_generator_3
description: Generates a gigawatt force field around the Headquarters that shields it from damage. If the generator is destroyed, the shield dissipates.

name: shock_blaster_1
description: The Shock Blaster shoots shock bullets at a high rate of fire, dealing heavy damage and stunning the target.

name: shock_blaster_2
description: The Shock Blaster shoots shock bullets at a high rate of fire, dealing massive damage and stunning the target.

name: shock_blaster_3
description: The Shock Blaster shoots shock bullets at a high rate of fire, dealing shocking damage and stunning the target.

name: shock_launcher
description: The Shock Launcher fires shock bombs, similar to those in your Gunboat's arsenal. Enemy troops caught in the area of effect are briefly stunned and unable to move or attack.

name: simo_1
description: Sniper tower that sniffs out and targets low health enemies within range. Can see through smoke with the help of infra-red sensors.

name: simo_2
description: Sniper tower that sniffs out and targets low health enemies within range. Can see through smoke with the help of infra-red sensors.

name: simo_3
description: Sniper tower that sniffs out and targets low health enemies within range. Can see through smoke with the help of infra-red sensors.

name: sky_shield_1
description: Sets up a defensive shield around itself, protecting all buildings under the shield from gunboat projectiles. The shield dissipates if it's bombarded enough or if the building is destroyed.

name: sky_shield_2
description: Sets up a defensive shield around itself, protecting all buildings under the shield from gunboat projectiles. The shield dissipates if it's bombarded enough or if the building is destroyed.

name: sky_shield_3
description: Sets up a defensive shield around itself, protecting all buildings under the shield from gunboat projectiles. The shield dissipates if it's bombarded enough or if the building is destroyed.

name: sniper_tower
description: The Sniper in the tower shoots at enemy attackers. He's armed with a long-range rifle that deals good damage.

name: bombardier
description: The Bombardiers can shoot with pin point accuracy from a large distance, dealing massive damage. They require extra energy to deploy as they are slightly older (but more experienced) than most troops.

name: clone_rifleman
description: 1... 2... wait what? These Riflemen multiply after being destroyed up to two times. Each clone is slightly weaker and deals less damage than the Rifleman before him.

name: critter_cannon
description: The critters' popularity and success in the battlefield inspired the creation of this prototype. Swamp enemies with these cute and deadly machines.

name: critter_engineer
description: This crafty Engineer has his own set of critters that he throws at enemy buildings.

name: cryobombardier
description: These Bombardiers throw ice bombs against enemy buildings, slowing them down and dealing moderate damage. They want everything to freeze, so they will always switch to unfrozen targets.

name: cryoneer
description: The Cryoneer freezes enemy buildings, slowing them down and dealing moderate damage. Your own troops are safe from the Freeze Beam.

name: cryotank
description: The CryoTank is a massive tank that freezes enemy buildings, slowing them down and dealing moderate damage. Each CyroTank requires extra Energy to land ashore.

name: dr_vitamin
description: Take your vitamins! Dr. Vitamin throws vitamins at other troops to boost one or many of their abilities for a short period of time.

name: grenadier
description: The Grenadier is a big and powerful ranged unit that deals area damage - rather inaccurately! Be careful about sending troops in front of him, as they might get caught in a grenade blast.

name: heavy
description: The Heavy can absorb a lot of damage and still keep on moving forward. He's happy to draw all the attention, and will take a punch to give a punch!

name: heavy_choppa
description: Like a buzzing wasp on a hot summer day, small and annoying and fires rockets at you!

name: hidden_warrior
description: This Tribal Warrior is hidden from enemy buildings and attacks, allowing him to sneak into enemy lines undetected. But once he starts attacking, the enemy will attack back!

name: incinerator
description: A more massive version of the scorcher, the MegaScorcher has more armor and causes bigger fires. It is also exceedingly large and takes a lot of energy to move.

name: laser_ranger
description: Laser Ranger uses her battery powered, handheld laser prototype to zap enemies in the line of sight.

name: lazortron
description: Breakthrough in the battery tech has allowed Blackguard to mount Lazor Beams on tanks. It will burn its way through enemy defenses with pinpoint precision.

name: mech
description: The Mech is a lean, mean fighting machine! He takes up a lot of space, but he can also take a lot of damage. His mighty autocannons stun their targets.

name: medic
description: Make love, not war! The Medic is opposed to all kinds of violence. Instead of grabbing a rifle, he heals other troops to help our cause.

name: melon_bombardier
description: The Bombardier is shooting... watermelons? Why not? Be careful though, these watermelons are exploding with flavor.

name: protector
description: This Native Islander is ready to help our cause against the Blackguard. She protects other troops with crystal shields for a short period of time.

name: rain_maker
description: This experimental long range artillery will outrange all but the most far-reaching defenses and rain down with its badaboom shells.

name: rifleman
description: Rifleman at the ready! Basic infantry units, the Riflemen are able to deal out and withstand moderate damage. In large enough numbers, they are almost unstoppable.

name: rocket_choppa
description: The flying clown car of the battlefield! Instead of laughs this unit delivers seemingly endless stream of bullets.

name: scorcher
description: The Scorcher is a massive, armored unit with a short range and attention span. It takes a boatload of Energy to deploy and leaves with a bang, harming everything nearby.

name: seeker
description: The Seeker is programmed to attack the nearest Engine Room, ignoring everything else. It can't be healed so make sure the path is clear!

name: shockaneer
description: The Shockaneer shocks enemy buildings, stunning them and dealing moderate damage. Enemies, beware of her Shock Beam!

name: stunner
description: The Stunner is one shockingly stunning troop that deals area damage - rather inaccurately! But his shock bomb grenades make up for his inaccuracy, stunning buildings and giving his teammates more time to attack.

name: tank
description: With its powerful gun and thick armor, the Tank is a real war machine! Due to its weight, each Tank needs extra Energy to land ashore.

name: turret_engineer
description: This crafty Engineer has designed compact turrets that expand upon hitting the ground and attack enemy buildings.

name: vampire_zooka
description: Vampire Zooka regains health as she shoots targets with her even longer range attack. She's moves quickly, so enemies should watch out!

name: warrior
description: The Tribal Warrior is an awesome sight in battle. He charges fearlessly, knowing that his Crystal Hammer will heal him with every blow.

name: zombie_rifleman
description: These Riflemen attack and respawn after being destroyed as slow, mindless zombies. Good luck trying to get these zombies to follow flares, Commander!

name: zooka
description: For long-range attacks, call in the Zooka. A few Zookas can completely devastate a whole enemy base, but don't let them come under fire from enemy turrets!

name: brick
description: After spending too long alone on the island, Sgt. Brick is ready to fight the Blackguard for real again.

name: bullit
description: It's not quite clear why Private Bullit has never been promoted, but it might have something to do with his attitude.

name: everspark
description: Some people just love gadgets. Cpt. Everspark takes after her mom, who has had a long career in weapons development.

name: kavan
description: Years in the jungle have had a pronounced effect on Dr. Kavan. He now uses natural oils to groom his moustache.

name: boom_mine
description: The Boom Mine stops the enemy in their tracks! Its high impact blast is focused in a small area.

name: mine
description: Mines trigger and explode when an enemy comes close. They deal area damage around them.

name: shock_mine
description: Shocking! Enemy troops caught in the area of effect are briefly stunned and unable to move or attack.

name: cluster_grenade
description: Throws a Cluster Grenade at the nearest building that not only explodes, but also peppers the area behind the target with explosive shrapnel.

name: iron_will
description: Mitigates damage taken by nearby troops for a duration.

name: battle_orders
description: Boosts damage and movement speed of nearby troops for a duration.

name: krystal_critters
description: Releases a cluster of crystal critters that heal wounded troops and disappear after a short duration.

name: ice_shields
description: Gives troops around the hero shields that absorb damage until destroyed. Excess damage from the hit that destroys the shield is negated.

name: second_wind
description: Temporarily revives fallen troops, except Seekers and Choppas. Latest casualties are revived first. If there is not enough capacity to revive a large troop, Riflemen appear instead.

name: critter_swarm
description: Releases a large swarm of critters.

name: explosive_charge
description: Throws a timed explosive that deals heavy damage at nearest defensive building.

name: universal_remote
description: Hacks the nearest defensive building and turns it against other defenses for a duration. Once the hacking effect expires, the building is stunned for a time. Cannot capture prototype weapons.

name: taunt
description: Limits maximum damage taken even more and taunts all defensive buildings within range, forcing them to shoot at the hero for a time.

name: energy_drink
description: Speeds up the hero's attack and movement while also granting him supernatural health regeneration.

name: shock_knuckles
description: Makes the hero attack the nearest defensive building with his fists, causing it and buildings behind it to be shocked.

name: ruddero
description: The Captain was rescued from a faraway island. Now he uses his experimental helipack to lead assaults from the air.

name: wingman_rush
description: Sends the wingmen forward to distract and shoot at enemies. Ruddero then rapidly deploys a new set of wingmen. Upgrading this ability also upgrades wingman stats.

name: bombing_run
description: Launches a bombing run in the direction Ruddero is facing. Flies in a line, then turns and comes back, dropping shrapnel bombs all the way.

name: mega_scorcher
description: The Scorcher is a massive, armored unit with a short range and attention span. It takes a boatload of Energy to deploy and leaves with a bang, harming everything nearby.

name: meatshield
description: Protects squad members by taking some of their damage on himself. Can redeploy troops freely anywhere on the battlefield.

name: zooka_fan
description: Aiming is overrated. You can shoot much farther if you fire upwards. Gives all squad members increased range but reduces accuracy.

name: minesweeper
description: All units in the squad clear Mines by walking into them when they are within range. Entire squad takes reduced damage from Mines.

name: clustardier
description: Uses a modified weapon that fires a barrage of bombs. They do less damage but destroy Mines.

name: bomb_and_shield
description: Each time a squad member is lost, remaining units in the squad gain a shield.

name: firebrand
description: Adds a burning effect to the squad's grenades. This causes continuous damage in a small area.

name: undercover_rifleman
description: These Riflemen are undercover, disguised as Blackguard troops. Enemy defenses will not attack them until the Riflemen start shooting.

name: heavy_fangirl
description: Julia is just a zooka girl. She has eaten with the heavies so she can take some additional hits and protect the others.

name: ninja_zooka
description: Squad members become stealthed if they have not attacked for a short while. Stealth is lost as soon as they attack.

name: mooka
description: Roberto has added a launcher to his zooka, so he can launch Flybots to demolish defenses He has also created Defenders to intercept incoming projectiles.

name: bunker
description: Bunkers allow you to garrison troops in your base. Troops can attack from inside the bunker. Some troops have extended range while in the bunker. The garrison cannot be stunned, taunted or frozen. When the bunker is destroyed, the garrison will leave the bunker and continue fighting.

name: adrenaline
description: Increases your units' movement and attack speed by {effect}.

name: support
description: Buildings transfer {effect} of damage taken to nearby buildings.

name: armor
description: Decreases the base damage per shot of enemy defenses by {secondaryEffect} but only up to {effect} reduction.

name: dampening
description: Decreases enemy defensive Statues' effectiveness by {effect}.

name: insulation
description: Reduces the duration of negative status effects on your troops by {effect}.

name: intel
description: Your troops gain {effect} of the opponent's offensive statue boosts.

name: leech
description: All units heal themselves {effect} of the damage they do.

name: motivation
description: Boosts your remaining units' speed by {effect} each time you lose a unit. Bigger units give more boost.

name: ordnance
description: Increases damage for Barrage and Artillery abilities by {effect}.

name: power_surge
description: Gives {effect} additional Gunboat energy for each destroyed building.

name: recycle
description: Increases loot gained by {effect} and converts looted construction resources to resource types you are missing.

name: sabotage
description: Decreases enemy defensive Statues' effectiveness by {effect}.

name: triage
description: Restores {effect} of lost units after a battle.

name: disruption
description: Reduces the effect of opponents' offensive statues by {effect}.

name: grounding
description: Reduces the amount of Gunboat energy opponents gain for each destroyed building by {effect}.

name: hardening
description: Reduces the damage of opponents' Gunboat abilities by {effect}.

name: insurance
description: Returns {effect} of the resources lost due to base being raided.

name: life_drain
description: Deals damage to attacker's units each second equal to {effect} of their base max health.

name: mind_control
description: You gain {effect} energy per second. At {secondaryEffect} energy resurrects fallen opponents to defend you.

name: mind_fog
description: Reduces the movement and attack speed of opponents' troops by {effect}.

name: overdrive
description: Increases the attack speed of your defenses by {effect}.

name: overheat
description: Gives opponent's Heroes and Leaders a {effect}s cooldown on their abilities.

name: shielding
description: Reduces the duration of negative status effects on your buildings by {effect}.

name: tinkering
description: You gain an additional prototype defense slot and Gunboat damage taken by prototypes is reduced by {effect}.

name: amani_kapata
description: Throws decoys towards enemy defenses instead of attacking. The decoys attract enemy fire like normal units.

name: antti_pylkas
description: Carries a drum-fed SMG with a lengthy burst attack and extended range, capable of quickly doing impressive damage.

name: freja_rygaard
description: Fires a laser beam in an arc in front of her.

name: honu
description: Uses his shield to take cover on the battlefield. He also carries self-made cherry bombs that he lobs in battle.

name: kai
description: Throws a projectile that bounces to multiple targets. Can throw a bomb that sets defenses on fire in an area.

name: linnea_friskdaul
description: Deals damage to defenses and can heal units on the battlefield based on damage dealt. Gives damage resistance to nearby units.

name: phasimov
description: Can fire a modified laser beam that temporarily phases targets. Phased targets can not shoot back, but any damage done is only applied when the target phases back.

name: firecrab
description: An ingenious flail device causes Mines to explode early, often damaging nearby buildings.

name: blobster
description: Transforms its turret based on incoming fire and shoots back using mimicked weaponry. Can also select which weapon to mimic.

name: doomfetti
description: Each squad member retreats once per battle after sufficiently damaged. Can deploy chaff to reduce defenses' range.

name: cr-cmd-010
description: Can be directed independently with a Squad Command. Gains a small speed boost for the command's duration.
